craft3d.ai.ANIME.title: AI is turning it into anime style
craft3d.ai.REAL.title: AI is finding the person
craft3d.ai.ANIME.done: Anime style is ready. You can switch back to the photo at any time.
craft3d.ai.REAL.done: Person found. Check the outline below, then confirm.
craft3d.ai.time: {n} s so far, cancel at any time
craft3d.ai.timeout: This took too long, so it stopped. Your photo is unchanged; you can retry.
craft3d.ai.cancelled: AI step cancelled. Your photo is unchanged.
craft3d.preview.alt: Along 3D bas-relief model. Drag to turn, pinch to zoom, or use the arrow keys.
craft3d.fit.title: Photo on the face
craft3d.fit.fillNote: The photo covers the whole face, and the face takes the photo's proportions. The shape trims only the edges; a watermark at the very edge may be cut.
craft3d.fit.wholeNote: The complete photo, with any watermark, sits inside the shape with a plain border around it. The photo is smaller.
craft3d.provider.proxy: a third-party model proxy (processing region and retention policy unverified)
craft3d.review.title: Review the main person region
craft3d.review.note: This is an approximate model-suggested outline, not precise segmentation or identity recognition. Confirm or refine it before relief generation. Check background and gaps carefully.
craft3d.review.pending: Suggestion awaiting confirmation. Your original and current model are unchanged.
craft3d.review.manualRequired: No reliable person outline was returned. Select the person manually; a rectangular location box will not be used as a person mask.
craft3d.review.canvas: Person suggestion review canvas. Add or erase regions manually.
craft3d.review.confidence: Model-reported confidence: {n}%. This is not an accuracy guarantee.
craft3d.review.refineNote: Add the person areas to raise and erase unwanted background, then confirm.
craft3d.review.resumeNote: This keepsake has a pending review task. Fetching it again will not call the model again.
craft3d.edit.ready: Anime is available: AI redraws the photo in anime style, then finds the person on that picture for you to confirm before it goes on the model. Usually 1–3 minutes; your original is kept.
craft3d.edit.unavailable: The configured model has no available anime image-editing channel. Anime generation is disabled; your original is preserved.
craft3d.detect.ready: AI can outline the figure in the current picture first; you confirm or adjust it.
craft3d.detect.unavailable: Person recognition is not available yet. Manual selection remains available.
craft3d.hold.disabled: Anime generation is unavailable. Holding will not submit a paid editing request. Buttons can still restore existing cached versions; the original is preserved.
craft3d.rotate.hint: Drag any way to turn the real mesh, and flick to let it spin. Pinch or use + and − to look closer; double-tap to face it front on. Arrow keys turn it; Home shows the front. The rear contains a magnet recess or a keychain through-hole.
craft3d.webgl: 3D rendering is unavailable on this device. This is a flat texture preview, not a 3D view. You can still build and download the real GLB/STL files.
craft3d.hold.hint: Hold the model still for 5 seconds to request anime. Movement cancels. In anime mode, hold to restore the cached original. The buttons below do the same without holding.
craft3d.variant.title: Your picture, two versions
craft3d.original.restored: Original restored from this device. No reverse AI request was made.
craft3d.provider.ready: Optional provider: {provider}. Nothing is uploaded until you consent.
craft3d.provider.unavailable: AI is not configured or is unavailable. No anime picture or person mask has been invented. You can manually select people below, or export a flat photo base.
craft3d.manual.title: Manual person mask · not AI
craft3d.manual.note: Paint the figure to raise and erase scenery or gaps. Painted areas become a bevelled relief; the rest stays flat.
craft3d.manual.keys: Touch or drag to paint. Keyboard: arrows move the brush; Space or Enter paints. Choose Erase to remove areas. Apply rebuilds the mesh.
craft3d.manual.canvas: Manual person selection canvas. Use arrows to move and Space or Enter to paint.
craft3d.relief.ai: Your confirmed person region is physically raised in front of flat scenery. The model outline is an approximate suggestion, not precise human segmentation; height is a designed bevel, not measured depth.
craft3d.relief.manual: Manual person selection: the selected area is a real raised mesh; unselected scenery stays flat. This is hand-selected bas-relief, not AI segmentation or a full 3D scan.
craft3d.relief.flat: Flat photo base: no usable person mask. There is no protruding person. Select people manually or use an available segmentation provider to add relief.
craft3d.geometry.error: The mesh could not be built. No printable model has been saved. Try a different size or selection.
craft3d.dimensions: {w} × {h} mm · base {b} mm · selected relief up to {r} mm
craft3d.product.MAGNET: Physical base with an 18 mm rear magnet pocket, 1.2 mm deep with a bevelled edge. Magnet not included.
craft3d.product.KEYCHAIN: Physical base with an approximately 5 mm through-hole for a ring. Ring not included.
craft3d.source.local: Newly imported original files stay on this device; they may retain location metadata. AI/cloud upload uses only a re-encoded copy after consent, never the original file automatically. Older records may have only the processed copy. Switching variants never overwrites your source.
craft3d.legacy: This is an older saved photo design, not a generated 3D model. Build and save the new model before treating it as a 3D keepsake.
craft3d.cache.missing: The anime cache is missing. The original has been restored; no AI request was made.
craft3d.consent.title: Before anything leaves this device
craft3d.consent.ai: Upload a metadata-stripped copy of this picture privately to Along, then send it to {provider} for the requested edit/segmentation? The provider may process faces. Only continue if you have permission from the people pictured. This does not publish a community post; the original stays on your device.
craft3d.consent.model: Privately upload the metadata-stripped source copy and this exact GLB/STL model to Along, and freeze an immutable version for a manual printing inquiry? The embedded photo is included in GLB. This does not publish the picture or place/pay for an order.
craft3d.consent.check: I have permission for the pictured people and agree to this specific private upload and processing.
craft3d.job.QUEUED: AI request queued… Your original is unchanged.
craft3d.job.PROCESSING: AI is processing the picture and its aligned mask…
craft3d.job.VALIDATING: Checking the returned image and aligned person mask before changing this version…
craft3d.job.READY: Provider result received and aligned. The original is still preserved separately.
craft3d.job.FAILED: The provider request or result validation failed. Your original is unchanged. Retry or use manual selection.
craft3d.job.CANCELLED: Cancelled. Late results will not replace this version.
craft3d.files.note: Real closed mesh: GLB includes the photo texture and uses metres; binary STL is geometry-only in millimetres. Background is flat. Manufacturing still requires professional checks for wall thickness, tolerances, colour and materials.
craft3d.saved: 3D files and this version saved on this device.
craft3d.download.started: Browser download requested. Check your browser's downloads; this is not confirmation of a saved file.
craft3d.download.native: 3D downloads use the browser, not the native image-saving bridge. Some app WebViews cannot save GLB/STL; open the web app in a full browser. A download request does not confirm a file was saved.
craft3d.export.error: The 3D files could not be encoded or saved. Nothing has been reported as successfully saved. Try again.
craft3d.make.note: Upload a private immutable version, then provide requirements for a manual quote. This is not instant checkout or a guarantee of printability.
craft3d.make.error: The private model could not be frozen. No printing inquiry was started. Check the connection, sign-in and service availability, then retry.
craft3d.library.sub: Your Along photo originals and real 3D keepsakes. Files remain local until you explicitly upload a version.
craft3d.style.title: Style
craft3d.style.generate: The first switch to anime asks AI to redraw the photo, about 1–3 minutes, and replaces the model above. After that both styles switch instantly without AI.
craft3d.style.cached: The anime picture is on this phone: switch any time, no AI call.
craft3d.style.animeOn: Showing the anime style. Switching back to real keeps the anime picture.
craft3d.style.animeReady: The anime picture replaced the model above. Your original photo is kept; switch back any time.
craft3d.style.switched: Style switched; the model was updated in place.
craft3d.hold.switch: You can also hold the model still for 5 seconds to switch style.
craft3d.raise.title: Raise the figure
craft3d.raise.off: Off: a flat base using only the picture. No painting needed.
craft3d.raise.on: On: paint the figure to raise below; unpainted scenery stays flat. Each style keeps its own selection.
craft3d.raise.empty: Raising is on but nothing is painted yet, so this is still a flat base.
craft3d.raise.carried: Started from the other style’s selection. Check it against this picture, adjust it, then tap Apply.
craft3d.raise.animeSourceMissing: This anime picture exists only on this phone, so AI cannot outline it. Paint the figure by hand.
craft3d.relief.flatChosen: Flat base: raising is off, the model uses only the picture.
